title: Fix it
summary: Applies the fix for the single lint finding on a Structure-tree node; an unused unit is removed or moved to implementation by compiling
intro: Read this when you are looking at one lint finding in the Structure form and want just that one fixed. Right-click the finding node and choose Fix it; an unused unit is removed or moved to the implementation section, verified by compiling.

surfaces.caption: Fix it
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)

surfaces.usage: drag-lint uses-fix <unit.pas> --project <dproj> --db <file.sqlite> [--platform win32|win64] [--apply] [--remove-unused] [--only <unit,...>] [--format json|text] (compiler-verified uses cleanup; --format json lists every candidate with a status -- verified | skipped | deselected -- and --only restricts which are compiled and written, so a reviewed partial apply is expressible; a unit --only names that is in the uses clause but in no project index -- an RTL/VCL/library unit -- is decided by compiling too: removed when it has no initialization section (with --remove-unused), else moved to the implementation section, else skipped)
help: drag-lint uses-fix <unit.pas> --project <dproj> --db <file.sqlite> [--platform win32|win64] [--apply] [--remove-unused] [--only <unit,...>] [--format json|text]   (compiler-verified uses cleanup; --format json lists every candidate with a status -- verified | skipped | deselected -- and --only restricts which are compiled and written, so a reviewed partial apply is expressible; a unit --only names that is in the uses clause but in no project index -- an RTL/VCL/library unit -- is decided by compiling too: removed when it has no initialization section (with --remove-unused), else moved to the implementation section, else skipped)

questions.ask: How do I fix just this one lint finding?
How do I remove an unused unit safely, verified by compiling?
